objections: What does this add beyond a blank seating grid?
It connects guest records, table capacity, meal and accessibility details, unassigned-guest reconciliation, and vendor handoff in one paid working system.
What if my guest list changes?
You can revise the editable worksheets and recreate the final handoff pages. The package includes a change-control checklist for late RSVPs and cancellations.
Does this replace my venue floor plan?
No. Use the venue-approved floor plan and capacity rules. This product organizes guests and handoff data; it does not certify occupancy or fire-code compliance.
